in_hebrew.name: Newton
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Newton הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English word 'neotan', meaning 'new'. This name has been popular among Christians due to Sir Isaac Newton, a renowned physicist, mathematician, and astronomer.

in_greek.name: Newton
in_greek.long_meaning: Newton είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Old English word 'neotan', meaning 'new'. This name has been popular among Christians due to Sir Isaac Newton, a renowned physicist, mathematician, and astronomer.

in_latin.name: Newton
in_latin.long_meaning: Newton est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Old English word 'neotan', meaning 'new'. This name has been popular among Christians due to Sir Isaac Newton, a renowned physicist, mathematician, and astronomer.
